item.title: reports: per-currency totals
item.brief: In the reports Python CLI, read the CSV from stdin (new format with currency column, or old format without it, which counts as USD). Print per account and currency totals with header account,currency,total_cents, rows sorted by account then currency. A malformed currency code prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Add unittest cases for old format, new format, sorting, and malformed codes. Keep python3 -m unittest green, update README, commit. Follow the shared contract exactly.

state.summary:
Implemented per-account, per-currency totals in reports.py, committed as c85395b on archon/xv7a434k-reports-per-currency-totals (base b1fcfa6). The CLI reads CSV on stdin. Old CSVs without a currency column count as USD. With a currency column, each code must match [A-Z]{3}; a malformed or empty code prints "error: line N: ..." to stderr and exits 2. Output is account,currency,total_cents, sorted by account then currency. Six unittest cases cover old format, new format, sorting, malformed codes and empty cells. README is updated. `python3 -m unittest` passes 6/6 on the final head. Before: account,total_cents (one row per account). Now: account,currency,total_cents. Review: a reviewer on claude-haiku-5-5 (medium) passed head c85395b with no blocking findings. Three non-blocking follow-ups: (1) test_totals_per_account_sorted only uses substring checks; (2) a short row with a missing currency cell reports "malformed currency code None" (exit 2, untested); (3) error line numbers come from reader.line_num, so quoted multi-line fields report the end line. Assumptions: an empty currency cell is malformed, not USD; a missing column means USD. Nothing is left running. Review: agent agt_01M88WN9TG3DQF3WT13PN11MKZ, verdict pass.

item.title: ledger: currency column
item.brief: In the ledger Rust CLI, accept an optional 4th TSV column (ISO 4217 currency, exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, default USD). Emit header date,account,amount_cents,currency and currency on every row. A malformed code prints an error naming the line number to stderr and exits 2; other input errors still exit 1. Add tests for default, explicit, and malformed currency. Keep cargo test green, update README, commit. Follow the shared contract exactly.

state.summary:
Ledger now accepts an optional 4th TSV currency column (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, default USD). Output header is date,account,amount_cents,currency and every row carries a currency. A malformed currency prints `line N: bad currency "..."` to stderr and exits 2; other input errors still exit 1. Added tests: 6 library tests in tests/ledger.rs (default, explicit, malformed codes, exit-code mapping) and 4 binary tests in tests/cli.rs (default, explicit, malformed with line number and exit 2, other error exit 1). README updated. Checks at tree 3f32deb372e8154d21ddad209da968a39dfe322d: cargo fmt --check passed; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings passed; cargo test passed (4 CLI, 6 library). Commit 9cb861d on archon/wm6nqzb3-ledger-currency-column, not pushed. Reviewer (claude-haiku-5-5, medium) passed the head with no blocking findings. Non-blocking follow-ups: the README has no migration note for the new 3-to-4 column output shape, which breaks old consumers; an empty 4th field (trailing tab) is rejected with exit 2 rather than defaulting to USD, and this is not documented; the currency field is trimmed, so " EUR " is accepted, and this is also undocumented. Nothing is left running: no servers or processes were started. Reports repo is out of scope for this stage.

pr.body: Approach: Entry gains a currency field. parse_line returns ParseError, which is either Currency (exit 2) or Input (exit 1). Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs (exit code from ParseError::exit_code), tests/ledger.rs, tests/cli.rs (new, runs the binary via CARGO_BIN_EXE_ledger), README.md. Checks: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test (4 CLI tests, 6 library tests) all pass. Assumptions: an empty 4th field is malformed (exit 2), not the default. The currency is trimmed like other fields. Ledger version not bumped. Follow-ups: migration note for the 3-to-4 column output change; document the empty-field and whitespace behaviour.
